# Three.js offline runtime

Three.js r160, MIT license, upstream https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r160 .

The bundled third-party three.min.js and THREE-LICENSE.txt are copied verbatim from the repository's already bundled Newton telescope vendor distribution to supply an independent offline runtime for the public SharedComponents.OpticalBeam component. No Newton implementation or runtime path is imported. License is retained alongside the runtime.
